action: Check the balance of any Woolworths WISH e-gift card now. If money is missing, contact Gift Card Support or register through the Everyday Gifting website to seek a replacement.
exec: Gift card fraud at Australia's largest grocer with an undisclosed cause; exposure is so far limited to individual card balances.
plain: Dozens of Woolworths shoppers found their digital gift cards had been spent by someone else. Woolworths says it is fixing the problem but has not explained the cause.
summary: An ABC News investigation published November 16 found dozens of customers whose digital WISH gift cards, mostly bought through Everyday Rewards, were emptied by transactions they did not make, with losses of up to $500. Woolworths acknowledged an issue affecting a number of e-gift cards. It has not said how card details were obtained or whether a cyberattack occurred, and nothing links it to the Coles incident.
title: Woolworths acknowledges issue after customers report drained digital gift cards

validation.note: One outlet relaying an ABC News investigation and Woolworths' acknowledgement; cause unknown.
